gauges.label: Large gain below a dam
gauges.note: Third largest gain of the 917 dammed gauges; the two above it are desert rivers with negative NSE in both arms.

gauges.label: Typical dammed gauge
gauges.note: Change in NSE equal to the dammed-gauge median; dam on the gauge reach, regulation 1.6.

gauges.label: Largest loss below a dam
gauges.note: The largest loss at any dammed gauge.

gauges.label: Typical undammed gauge
gauges.note: Change in NSE equal to the undammed median.
